story: DNA copying happens in S phase before mitosis. Follow chromosome sets through nuclear division and animal-cell cytokinesis.

aha.observation: Separated sisters count as chromosomes; the whole view still contains the same DNA molecules.

links.label: Next cycle after division, growth + DNA copying

states.label: Already copied
states.sentence: Before mitosis: Chromosomes already contain sister DNA copies made in S phase.
states.why: S phase copied DNA; this context is not a mitosis phase.

states.label: Copies condense
states.sentence: Prophase: Chromosomes condense with their sister copies still joined.
states.why: Condensation packages long DNA molecules for separation.

states.label: Copies attach
states.sentence: Prometaphase: Sister chromatids gain spindle attachments but remain joined.
states.why: Attachment lets the spindle move each sister independently.

states.label: Copies line up
states.sentence: Metaphase: Chromosomes line up; sisters face opposite spindle poles.
states.why: Opposite attachments prepare one sister for each pole.

states.label: Sisters separate
states.sentence: Anaphase: Sisters separate into chromosomes, without making new DNA.
states.why: Separated sisters count as chromosomes, without new DNA.

states.label: Nuclei re-form
states.sentence: Telophase: Nuclei re-form around matching chromosome sets at the poles.
states.why: Nuclear envelopes rebuild around the separated sets.

states.label: Cytoplasm divides
states.sentence: Cytokinesis: Chromosomes stay in new nuclei as the cytoplasm separates.

states.label: Matching daughters
states.sentence: Daughter cells: Each nucleus contains a matching chromosome set.
states.why: Growth and another S phase precede the next division.

links.label: Next cycle after division, growth + DNA copying

states.label: Spindle not ready
states.sentence: Before mitosis: The spindle is not assembled; centrosomes await mitosis.
states.why: S phase copied DNA; this context is not a mitosis phase.

states.label: Spindle assembles
states.sentence: Prophase: The spindle assembles as centrosomes move apart.
states.why: Condensation packages long DNA molecules for separation.

states.label: Spindle attaches
states.sentence: Prometaphase: Spindle fibers reach sister chromatids through the open nucleus.
states.why: Attachment lets the spindle move each sister independently.

states.label: Opposite poles
states.sentence: Metaphase: Spindle fibers attach sister copies to opposite poles.
states.why: Opposite attachments prepare one sister for each pole.

states.label: Fibers shorten
states.sentence: Anaphase: Spindle fibers shorten to move chromosomes apart.
states.why: Separated sisters count as chromosomes, without new DNA.

states.label: Spindle dissolves
states.sentence: Telophase: The spindle disassembles as new nuclei re-form.
states.why: Nuclear envelopes rebuild around the separated sets.

states.label: Spindle has gone
states.sentence: Cytokinesis: The spindle is gone as the furrow finishes dividing the cell.

states.label: Spindle absent
states.sentence: Daughter cells: The spindle is absent; a centrosome remains near each nucleus.
states.why: Growth and another S phase precede the next division.
